mind-poisoning.name: mind_poisoning
mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE: conservative affinity updates from identity-checked NPC acknowledgements and Player input, with optional single-type judgments, actor-owned reflection, default-off NPC ACK overhearing, canonical Player handling, sentinel exclusion, and a read-only dashboard. Evaluations may receive existing owner-to-subject relation, note, best, and worst strings (up to 160 UTF-8 bytes each). They are untrusted context; no extra model call or relationship state is added. The topic-discovery asset needs a newer CHIM manager and standard release classification. Isolated PHP checks pass; provider, database, installation, and gameplay remain unverified.
